**Finding: missing** (TRANSITION) — validated redline submitted.

The Agreement has no post-termination transition-assistance or data-return obligation:
- **§10.1** ends our access "after any agreed transition period" but never creates such a period or any assistance duty.
- **§10.2** covers only Deliverable delivery and Fee refunds.
- **§16.5** returns/destroys *Confidential Information* only and expressly defers Customer Data to "Sections 11 and 15" — but **Section 11 does not exist** in the document, and Section 15 contains only processing-limitation and privacy terms with no return, export or deletion mechanic.

That gap fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance + 30-day export) and risks the walk-away outcome of no data return at all. I inserted a new **§10.3** at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return/extraction of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (subject to routine backups and legal retention, consistent with §16.5). The comment offers 90 days as a fallback if the six-month period is resisted.
